faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support 1 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Technical Support 1 post at AIIMS Nagpur is 28 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support 1 position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 10th pass with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) and two years of experience, or a three-year Graduate degree with one year of experience. A BSc MLT with specific lab experience is also considered.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support 1 post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support 1 position is 28 years. Age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support 1 role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18000 per month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Technical Support 1 position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Written Test (MCQ based), followed by a Skill Assessment, and finally an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only. Ensure you complete the process before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. Where is AIIMS Nagpur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 441108.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technical Support 1 at AIIMS Nagpur is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: While the notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Maharashtra, it's advisable to check the official notification for specific state eligibility criteria.
